title: Add Cards Grid
content: Create responsive card grid layout with reusable card component. Grid container: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Card structure: image container with aspect ratio (aspect-video), content area with padding (p-4 or p-6). Include: image with hover zoom effect, category badge, title (font-semibold truncate), description (line-clamp-2), metadata row (date, author, read time), action buttons or link. Add hover effect: shadow increase, slight lift (-translate-y-1). Loading state with skeleton cards. Empty state when no items. Consider masonry layout variant for varying heights.

variants.advanced: Create responsive card grid layout with reusable, accessible card component. Grid container: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6, with container padding px-4. Card component structure: article element (or div with proper semantics), bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow overflow-hidden. Image area: aspect-video or aspect-[4/3] relative overflow-hidden, img with object-cover w-full h-full, hover zoom effect using group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300. Category badge: absolute top-4 left-4, z-10 bg-blue-600 text-white text-xs font-medium px-2 py-1 rounded. Content area: p-4 or p-5 flex flex-col gap-2. Title: h3 font-semibold text-lg line-clamp-2 or truncate, link wrapper for clickable cards. Description: text-gray-600 text-sm line-clamp-2 or line-clamp-3. Metadata row: flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-gray-500, include date (Calendar icon), author (avatar or User icon), read time (Clock icon). Tags: flex flex-wrap gap-1 with small badges. Actions: flex justify-between items-center mt-auto pt-4, can include Like button, Share button, primary CTA. Card link: make entire card clickable with stretched link technique (a::after absolute inset-0) or wrap in Link. Hover effects: -translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg on card, image zoom, optional border highlight. Loading state: skeleton cards matching exact layout with animate-pulse bg-gray-200. Empty state: centered message with illustration, "No items found", and optional CTA. Masonry variant: use CSS columns or masonry library for varying heights. List view toggle: alternative single-column horizontal card layout. ACCESSIBILITY: proper heading levels, alt text on images, keyboard-focusable cards with visible focus ring.
